verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-driven payments and identity platform like Skyfire. However, the evidence documents only single-item operations: charging one token, introspecting one token, and creating tokens one at a time via API or MCP tools. Repeated charges against a single token are not a bulk or batch capability across many items, and no batch endpoint for tokens, charges or agents is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
